decisions.reason: As a newly launched product line close to the core offer and given its own webpage, it reflects meaningful investment and visible commitment, so management would be reluctant to withdraw it so soon.

Although website commitment is weaker because it was only mentioned, it builds directly on the firm's automation-focused established business, so management is likely to continue and justify the launch as needing more time.
This is a product line close to the existing range, and the broader investment in multiple models makes withdrawal less attractive even if market traction is still uncertain.
Its own webpage and status as a multi-model line indicate stronger public and resource commitment, which under escalation of commitment favors continuation.
The product is close to the established offer and was presented on its own page, so management would tend to keep it on the market rather than quickly admit a mistaken launch.

This product has the weakest visible commitment because it was only mentioned and is not described as a broader line, but its closeness to the core business still makes near-term withdrawal less likely than continuation.
